title: Hajj in Perspective
description: Understanding the spiritual significance and practical aspects of Hajj (حج) from an authentic Islamic perspective. Explore the wisdom behind the rites, the prophetic methodology, and the transformation this pilgrimage brings to the believer.
short_description: Explore the deeper meanings and spiritual significance of Hajj

modules.title: The Wisdom Behind Hajj
modules.description: Understanding the profound wisdom and spiritual lessons of the pilgrimage.

lessons.title: The Fifth Pillar of Islam
lessons.content: Understanding Hajj (حج) as the fifth pillar of Islam, its obligation, and the conditions that make it obligatory upon a Muslim.

lessons.title: The Virtues of Hajj
lessons.content: The tremendous rewards and virtues of Hajj (فضائل الحج) as mentioned in the Qur'an and authentic Sunnah.

lessons.title: The Prophetic Hajj
lessons.content: Studying the Hajj of the Prophet (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم) - the Farewell Pilgrimage - and extracting the key lessons from his methodology.

modules.title: Spiritual Transformation Through Hajj
modules.description: How the rites of Hajj transform the believer and renew their faith.

lessons.title: Standing at Arafah
lessons.content: The significance of Wuquf (وقوف) - standing - at Arafah (عرفة) and why the Prophet (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم) said 'Hajj is Arafah'.

lessons.title: Rejection of Shaytan
lessons.content: The wisdom behind stoning the Jamarat (رمي الجمرات) - symbolizing the rejection of Shaytan's temptations and the resolve to obey Allah.

lessons.title: Returning as a Newborn
lessons.content: The prophetic description of the pilgrim returning as a newborn (كيوم ولدته أمه) - the spiritual renewal and purification that Hajj brings.
